units.source_text: 紫儿忌期过后[\[25\]](#part1334.html#m25)，从北山迁回京邸。

en.t: After Zi'er's mourning period had passed, she moved back from Kitayama to the residence in the capital.

units.source_text: 源氏公子闻此消息，便在几天之后择一个闲暇的黄昏，亲自前去访问。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this news, he chose a quiet evening a few days later and went to visit in person.

units.source_text: 但见邸内荒凉沉寂，人影寥寥，想见那可怜的幼女住在这里多么胆怯啊！

en.t: He found the residence desolate and silent, with hardly a person in sight, and imagined how frightened the poor little girl must feel living there.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母照例引导公子到朝南的那间厢房里请坐，啼啼哭哭地向公子详述姑娘孤苦伶仃之状，使得公子涕泪满襟。

en.t: As usual, Shonagon the nurse led the prince to sit in the south-facing side room, and, weeping all the while, described the girl's lonely and helpless state in such detail that his sleeves were soaked with tears.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母说：“本当送姑娘到她父亲兵部卿大人那里去。

en.t: Shonagon the nurse said, "We ought properly to send the young lady to her father, His Lordship the Minister of War.

units.source_text: 可是已故的老太太说：‘她妈妈生前认为兵部卿的正妻冷酷无情。

en.t: But the late old lady said, 'Her mother, while she was alive, thought the Minister of War's principal wife was cold and heartless.

units.source_text: 现在这孩子既非全然无知无识，却又未解人情世故，正是个不上不下之人。

en.t: Now this child is no longer completely ignorant, yet she still does not understand the ways of the world, so she is at a most awkward age.

units.source_text: 将她送去，教她夹在许多孩童之间，能不受人欺侮？

en.t: If we send her there and place her among so many children, how could she avoid being bullied?'

units.source_text: ’老太太直到临死还为此事忧愁叹息呢。

en.t: The old lady worried and sighed over this matter right up to her death.

units.source_text: 现在想来，可虑之事的确甚多。

en.t: Thinking of it now, there truly are many things to be anxious about.

units.source_text: 因此之故，承蒙公子不弃，有此一时兴到之言，我等也顾不得公子今后是否变心，但觉在此境况之下的确很可感谢。

en.t: For that reason, since Your Highness has not cast her aside and has spoken even what might be a passing impulse, we cannot afford to worry whether your feelings may change later; in these circumstances, we can only feel deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 只是我家姑娘娇憨成性，不像那么大年纪的孩子，只有这一点放心不下。”

en.t: Only, our young lady is naturally spoiled and innocent, unlike other children of her age, and that alone leaves me uneasy."

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“我几次三番表白我的衷心诚意，决非一时兴到之言，你又何必如此过虑呢？

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "I have shown my sincere feelings again and again; they are certainly not words spoken on a passing impulse, so why must you worry so much?

units.source_text: 小姐的天真烂漫之相，我觉得非常可怜可爱。

en.t: I find the young lady's innocent, open nature deeply touching and very lovable.

units.source_text: 我确信此乃特殊之宿缘。

en.t: I am convinced this is a special bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 现在勿劳你等传达，让我和小姐直接面谈，如何？

en.t: Now, instead of troubling you all to carry messages, may I speak with the young lady directly?"
